goal: Under [store] backend = postgres, worker-driven runs land their complete run records and claims in the configured postgres database with nothing written to sqlite and no task double-claimed across concurrent instances.

graders.name: behavior
graders.run: bash -c 's=$(uv run pytest packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_postgres_data_plane.py -q 2>&1); r=$?; echo "$s"; [ "$r" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -qi skipped && exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -q " passed"'

graders.name: contention
graders.run: bash -c 's=$(uv run pytest packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_postgres_claim_contention.py -q 2>&1); r=$?; echo "$s"; [ "$r" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -qi skipped && exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -q " passed"'

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- the run loop constructs SqliteClaimStore unconditionally (~line 2277) and drives runs via db_path only; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_store_factory.py -- build_store already routes the core store on policy.store_backend; extend the same factory discipline to claim stores
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims_postgres.py -- PostgresClaimStore, complete but constructed nowhere in production; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_policy.py -- store_backend/store_schema fields and the distributed-mode guard (read-only reference)
constraints: One policy-driven factory is the single production construction point for claim stores; the run datapath store comes from the same policy-built factory through the injection seam shipped by core-run-store-injection
The read-only sites that still hardcode SqliteClaimStore (_workflow.py stop-event reads, _autopilot_run.py backoff reads) are a follow-on task -- leave their sqlite behavior intact here
DSN resolution stays FLYWHEEL_PG_DSN then DATABASE_URL; schema selection stays policy.store_schema
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change claim/lease semantics, scheduling, or the DAG
Do not add repo-identity columns or any cross-repo pooling -- multi-repo isolation is schema-per-repo (spec D-1)
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Dual-write must fail: after a postgres-backed run, the repo's sqlite db path is absent or byte-identical to its pre-run state
A contention test that serializes the two claimants must fail -- each claimant must obtain at least one claim while every task is claimed exactly once
The full record lands in postgres -- task_versions, lifecycles, attempts, grader_results, events, task_claims each carry rows for the run
